summary: Named in a Georgia tower list (2016) and a topo-map directory for Coweta County; no source found on its build, design, owner or current state.

notes_for_editor: Two listings name the tower: the tnlandforms Georgia list (2016; coordinates, Coweta County, elevation 996 with no unit label, read as feet) and a Topo Zone tower list (name and USGS quad Madras only). Neither describes the structure or its condition. The NHLR and FFLOS Georgia lists do not include it, and the record has no register number. The Waycross sentence is general context, not about this site. Field check needed before any claim about the tower standing.
